outgoing.name: Bill Clinton
outgoing.excerpt: President Bill Clinton declared a federal state of emergency in both Florida and Georgia in anticipation of the storm's approach.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: With a death toll of 57, Hurricane Floyd was the deadliest United States hurricane since Hurricane Agnes in 1972.

outgoing.name: United States dollar
outgoing.excerpt: In total, Floyd was responsible for 57 fatalities and $4.5 billion ($5.1 billion in 2005 U.S. dollars) in damage, mostly in North Carolina.
